sources.subject: ऐच्छिक गणित
sources.note: Official government PDF page 1 verified: 75 marks, 3h, 11 objective 1-mark items (11), 12 WCA grouped questions (40), 4 CCA cross-content grouped questions (24), 6 content areas marks 17/17/20/7/7/7, domains K16% U24% A40% HA20%, each composite question 2-4 subquestions. Existing flat MCQ/short/long allocator MUST NOT claim CDC compliance. Teacher needs no manual Excel grid entry; grouped-question generation remains disabled.

sources.subject: ऐच्छिक गणित
sources.note: CDC official page dated 23 Asar 2083 confirms newer Grade10 Optional Mathematics Grid, Model Question and Marking Scheme. Secondary-hosted PDF reproduces 2083 model with 11 Objective, 12 WCA, 4 CCA, 75 marks/3hr, area marks 17/17/20/7/7/7, identical to 2082 published specification. Exact original 2083 government PDF attachment unavailable in machine-readable page; do not label PDF copy as government authenticated. SMSS only creates original practice questions, not official CDC questions.

sources.subject: विज्ञान तथा प्रविधि
sources.note: CDC catalog identifies a 12-page 2078 Grade8 Science grid, bilingual Model Question and Answer Key. Dhangadhi government archive search-readable PDF contains 'grid 40' but model '50' within the Grade8 Science pages, and screenshot retrieval failed. Independent 2078 model synopsis reports 50 marks, 2 hours, 10 MCQ(1), 8 very short(1), 8 short(2), 4 long(4), 30 items and 11 unit areas. This record is historical reference ONLY. No verified 2083 Grid row is transcribed or approved; do not automatically use this for the current CDC exact generator.

sources.subject: ऐच्छिक अर्थशास्त्र
sources.note: Government-hosted CDC Grade 9 Economics (103) PDF; text-extracted bilingual model and summary table agree on 75 marks, 3h, 22 required items: 11×1, 8×5, 3×8; alternatives at model Q12,16,18,22 (not extra scored items). Six unit totals read as 9/24/9/6/12/15; cognitive summary marks 13/24/17/21. Extracted prose conflicts with the summary/model (5 short items, 5-mark long items, higher ability cap 20% vs 28% summary). Page screenshots timed out; original row/cell visual confirmation and clarification of conflicting prose still required. No exact blueprint approved; no automatic generation enabled by this source.

sources.subject: अनिवार्य गणित
sources.note: Government PDF page 1 visually checked: 75 marks, 3 hours, 16 grouped questions, 49 subitems; seven area marks 6/13/13/15/13/11/4; cognitive marks 12/18/30/15. Grade 9 model is present. The PDF expressly dates its grid to 2078; the 2082 official listing date alone does not establish that the PDF is the latest applicable revision. Archive reference only until current applicability is verified.

sources.subject: अनिवार्य अङ्ग्रेजी
sources.note: Government PDF cover and grid visually verified: reading 40 (5/10/10/15), writing 35 (5/5/6/8 plus grammar 11), total 75, 3h. Reading requires two textbook and two unseen passages with distinct comprehension task patterns; grammar includes six 1-mark transformations and ten half-mark contextual choices. The included model is Grade 10, not Grade 9. Current Grade 9 model applicability and reviewed passage bank remain pending; do not automatically approve CDC Exact.

completion.scienceSourceDiscovery: CDC textbook and teacher-guide sources identified for Grades 6–10; Grade 8 and Grade 10 textbook unit lists seeded; Grade 6, 7 and 9 topic extraction and subject-specific grid parsing remain pending

completion.verifiedOptionalComputerGrid: Official Grade 9/10 Computer Science grid PDFs transcribed unit/type/marks/cognitive levels for 50-mark paper; development only, source checked, teacher answer review required; other subjects not configured.
completion.optionalMath2082: Official Grade 9/10 Optional Math source area totals and WCA/CCA composite question groups verified and bundled; exact automated grouped question generation pending. Not equivalent to simple MCQ/Short/Long.
completion.grade10OptionalMathModel2083: Grade10 CDC 2083 publication confirmed. Secondary-hosted model PDF table compared against 2082 original government grid: all group counts, group marks, 6 area marks, cognitive percentage identical; original CDC 2083 PDF download not yet independently accessed. Printer follows CDC Q1(A-K), Q2-13, Q14-17.
completion.grade8ScienceModelArchive2078: Model 2078 four-group format 50/30 documented from CDC catalog, municipality archive text and independent synopsis; 11 unit weights staged for comparative audit. Municipality archive text contains Grid 40 vs Model 50 inconsistency; direct 2082 CDC primary PDF not visually available. Grade8 existing 55-item bank has 22 1-mark MCQs, 22 5-mark short and 11 10-mark long (missing 8×1 very short, 8×2 short, 4×4 long). CDC Exact remains blocked pending reconciliation, teacher review and bank expansion.
completion.grade9AllSubjects: Nine-subject audit covers 5 compulsory subjects and 4 known electives (actual school electives must be checked against School Settings). Government pages found for Nepali/English/Math/Science/Social, 2081 Accounting, 2082 Optional Economics, Optional Mathematics and Optional Computer Science. Only Computer and Optional Maths Grid transcriptions bundled, both need proper reviewed paper banks and teacher testing. Never deploy Grade9 question-paper claims until gate closes.
completion.grade9ScienceArchivedGrid: 2078 archived CDC PDF transcribed for comparison: 75 marks, 40 items, 19 units. Original screenshot failed; 2082 revised Science Grid primary table remains unverified. Legacy Grid blocked from 2083 exact-paper generation.
